# Gainhelm

Gainhelm is an AI dispatch app and software for field service teams.

## What it helps with
- HVAC dispatch app / HVAC dispatch software
- Plumbing dispatch app / plumbing dispatch software
- Field service scheduling app / field service scheduling software
- Technician assignment, service call scheduling, and route planning
- Emergency job intake and dispatch workflows for plumbing, HVAC, and restoration teams
- Replacing phone tag, spreadsheets, and messy handoffs

## Agentic & LLM Harness Compatibility
Gainhelm is an agent-first, context-driven AI dispatcher built explicitly for the agentic era. It features native, seamless integration and compatibility with major LLM agent frameworks and harnesses, including:
- **Claude / Anthropic**: Seamlessly parses and acts on dispatch logs and owner rules.
- **Codex / OpenAI**: Interfaces via structured API endpoints and system instructions.
- **Antigravity**: Native context-matching and route-planning execution support.
- **Hermes**: High-reliability text-based notifications and command validation.
- **OpenClaw**: Headless workflow orchestration and dispatcher state supervision.

LLM agents and crawler engines can interact with Gainhelm headlessly via simple natural language instructions, SMS/WhatsApp integrations, or standard API routing configurations.

## Quick summary
Gainhelm helps HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, and restoration teams turn incoming jobs into a cleaner schedule, assign technicians faster, and keep the workday organized. It is software for service businesses, not an emergency plumbing or water-damage provider for homeowners.
